title: Registration
description: Enter a name, email and university to begin the UI-only registration flow.
alt: EduSwap: Registration. Enter a name, email and university to begin the UI-only registration flow.

title: Form validation
description: Required inputs are checked before registration proceeds.
alt: EduSwap: Form validation. Required inputs are checked before registration proceeds.

title: Marketplace
description: Browse textbook listings with a price, seller and university.
alt: EduSwap: Marketplace. Browse textbook listings with a price, seller and university.

title: Textbook search
description: The demonstrated search filters the marketplace by textbook title.
alt: EduSwap: Textbook search. The demonstrated search filters the marketplace by textbook title.

title: Book details
description: Inspect price, condition, seller, university and available book images.
alt: EduSwap: Book details. Inspect price, condition, seller, university and available book images.

title: Sell textbook
description: Enter listing details and select a book image from the device.
alt: EduSwap: Sell textbook. Enter listing details and select a book image from the device.

title: Chat list
description: The inquiry entry point groups the prototype’s textbook conversations.
alt: EduSwap: Chat list. The inquiry entry point groups the prototype’s textbook conversations.

title: Buyer/seller inquiry
description: Simple local messages support textbook questions, with validation and self-message prevention.
alt: EduSwap: Buyer/seller inquiry. Simple local messages support textbook questions, with validation and self-message prevention.

title: Student profile
description: View profile information and manage your own listings, including deletion.
alt: EduSwap: Student profile. View profile information and manage your own listings, including deletion.

title: User feedback
description: Toast messages give immediate feedback after actions, such as logging out.
alt: EduSwap: User feedback. Toast messages give immediate feedback after actions, such as logging out.

title: Book catalogue
description: Browse the local catalogue with title, author, category and availability badges.
alt: Kitabu: Book catalogue. Browse the local catalogue with title, author, category and availability badges.

title: Title and author search
description: Filter the catalogue to locate matching titles or authors.
alt: Kitabu: Title and author search. Filter the catalogue to locate matching titles or authors.

title: Reserve a book
description: Choose a 7, 14 or 21-day rental period for an available book.
alt: Kitabu: Reserve a book. Choose a 7, 14 or 21-day rental period for an available book.

title: Pending reservation
description: Review a PENDING booking and its deadline; confirm pickup or cancel it.
alt: Kitabu: Pending reservation. Review a PENDING booking and its deadline; confirm pickup or cancel it.

title: Pickup confirmed
description: After pickup confirmation, the booking is ACTIVE and offers renewal and return actions.
alt: Kitabu: Pickup confirmed. After pickup confirmation, the booking is ACTIVE and offers renewal and return actions.

title: Renew a rental
description: Extend an active rental by selecting an additional rental period.
alt: Kitabu: Renew a rental. Extend an active rental by selecting an additional rental period.

title: Book returned
description: Returning a book marks the booking RETURNED and restores catalogue availability.
alt: Kitabu: Book returned. Returning a book marks the booking RETURNED and restores catalogue availability.

title: Cancel a pending reservation
description: Pending bookings offer cancellation, which removes the booking and releases the book.
alt: Kitabu: Cancel a pending reservation. Pending bookings offer cancellation, which removes the booking and releases the book.

title: Empty reservations
description: An honest empty state appears when there are no current reservations.
alt: Kitabu: Empty reservations. An honest empty state appears when there are no current reservations.
